parts.script:
Anna: Hey Mark, are you excited about our trip this weekend?  
Mark: Absolutely! I’ve been looking forward to it for weeks.  
Anna: Great! Have you decided what to pack?  
Mark: I’m planning to bring my hiking gear and some casual clothes. What about you?  
Anna: I’ll pack my camera for sure. I want to capture some beautiful moments in the mountains.  
Mark: That sounds good! Are we still going to hike the Blue Ridge Trail?  
Anna: Yes! It’s supposed to have amazing views. I heard it can be challenging, though.  
Mark: Well, I think we’ll manage. We should also check the weather forecast to prepare.  
Anna: Right, I hope it stays clear. Let's meet at my place Friday evening to finalize our plans.  
Mark: Sounds perfect! Should we bring any snacks for the trip?  
Anna: Definitely! I can prepare some sandwiches and we can grab some fruit too.  
Mark: Awesome! I’m really looking forward to this outdoor adventure!  
Anna: Me too! It’s going to be a lot of fun!
